# Assets Directory

This directory contains brand assets and generated images.

## Required Files

- **logo.png** - AIRMAN brand logo (transparent PNG, will be composited on generated images)

## Generated Files (Auto-created)

- `generated_*.jpg` - AI-generated images from Imagen 4.0 (temporary, deleted after posting)
- `gemini_test_output.jpg` - Test output from API tests

## Sample Files

- `sunset.jpg` - Sample image for testing

---

**Note**: Generated images are automatically cleaned up after posting to Instagram.
